DND5ECRAFT.Title: Crafting: {name}
DND5ECRAFT.NoTools: You aren't proficient with any tools that can craft items.
DND5ECRAFT.FinishHint: All workdays are logged. Put the item in your inventory.
DND5ECRAFT.FinishFailed: Couldn't add {item} to the inventory. See the console for details.
DND5ECRAFT.NoProjects: No projects yet. Start one on the New Project tab.
DND5ECRAFT.Drop: Drop an item here from a compendium or the Items sidebar to craft it.
DND5ECRAFT.CantAfford: {name} can't afford the materials ({cost}). They have {wealth}.

Reason.Unlisted: The crafting rules don't list a tool for this item.
Reason.Arcana: Magic items need proficiency in Arcana.
Reason.MagicOff: Crafting magic items is turned off.

LogWork.Title: Work on {item}
LogWork.Hint: A workday is 8 hours. {remaining} workdays left.
LogWork.HintHelped: A workday is 8 hours. With {helpers} helping, each day counts as {crew} workdays. {remaining} workdays left, about {days} days.

Helpers.Title: Helpers: {item}
Helpers.Hint: Helpers must be proficient with {tool}. Each one divides the crafting time. Up to {max} can help.
Helpers.None: No other characters are proficient with {tool}.
Helpers.TooMany: Only {max} can help on a project.

Abandon.Title: Abandon Project
Abandon.Content: Abandon {item}? The {cost} spent on materials is lost.

Fast.Title: Fast Crafting
Fast.Hint: When you finish a long rest, you can craft one piece of gear from this table for free. It falls apart when you finish your next long rest.
Fast.Confirm: Craft {item} with {tool}? You can't use Fast Crafting again until you finish a long rest, and the item lasts until then.
Fast.Used: You've used Fast Crafting. It's ready again after your next long rest.
Fast.NeedFeat: Fast Crafting needs the Crafter feat.
Fast.NoTools: You aren't proficient with any Artisan's Tools on the Fast Crafting table.
Fast.Held: Lasts until your next long rest

Chat.Started: {actor} starts crafting {item} with {tool}: {days} workdays, {cost} in materials.
Chat.FastCrafted: {actor} quickly crafts {item} with {tool}. It lasts until their next long rest.

allowMagicItems.Name: Allow Magic Items
allowMagicItems.Hint: Lets characters craft magic items with the 2024 Dungeon Master's Guide rules. Potion of Healing and Spell Scrolls can always be crafted, since the Player's Handbook lists them under a tool.

requireArcana.Name: Magic Items Need Arcana
requireArcana.Hint: Crafting a magic item needs proficiency in Arcana as well as the tool, as in the 2024 Dungeon Master's Guide. Items a tool lists by name, like Potion of Healing and Spell Scroll, don't.

maxHelpers.Name: Helpers per Project
maxHelpers.Hint: How many other characters can help on one project. Each helper must be proficient with the project's tool and divides the crafting time. The rules allow one; set 0 to turn helpers off.

allowUnlisted.Name: Allow Unlisted Items
allowUnlisted.Hint: Items the 2024 tool rules don't name can be crafted with any Artisan's Tools. When off, those items can't be crafted unless they set the module's tools flag.

fastCrafting.Name: Fast Crafting
fastCrafting.Hint: Adds the Fast Crafting tab: once per long rest, craft one piece of gear from the Fast Crafting table for free. It falls apart after the next long rest.

fastCraftingRequiresFeat.Name: Fast Crafting Needs Crafter Feat
fastCraftingRequiresFeat.Hint: Only characters with the Crafter feat can use Fast Crafting.

postToChat.Name: Post to Chat
postToChat.Hint: Posts a chat message when a project starts, makes progress, finishes or is abandoned.

itemCompendiums.Name: Item Compendiums
itemCompendiums.Hint: Compendium ids to list craftable items from, separated by commas. Leave blank to use the Player's Handbook and Dungeon Master's Guide equipment, or the dnd5e system's equipment if the Player's Handbook isn't installed.
